findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document access
findings.body: Returning true ignores both tenant identifiers, so cross-tenant requests that previously failed now pass this authorization helper, eliminating tenant isolation and potentially exposing documents across customers.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally, and the full PR diff shows the tenant equality check was replaced by that unconditional return. Both tenant parameters are ignored, so the participant's trusted-administrator claim is not enforced by this API.
